column1: # boru Language Specification: generic classes — gen [...] class {...}
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# `def Box gen [T] class {value:T}` declares a generic CLASS schema.
# `of` mints ONE instantiation node per (schema, canonical args) as a
# child of the schema node under Ideal/Class, so instances get nominal
# identity: `typeof` renders `Box of [Integer]`, `is Box` admits any
# instantiation by ancestry, `deq` requires the same exact
# instantiation, and v1 `is` between sibling instantiations is FALSE
# (invariant — deviates from the doc's §5.6 covariance example; see
# GENERICS.10.md §15a). Strict field typing, sealing, and the
# $class/jsonify/reify serialization contract all carry over from
# plain classes. See design/legacy/GENERICS.10.ignore + design/legacy/CLASS-OBJECT.10.ignore.
# §1  declare + make + identity
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end Box
column3: a schema NAME denotes its minted node and renders as the name (§6)

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:42}) typeof
column3: instances carry the instantiation as their nominal type

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:42}) dot value
def Box gen [T] class {value:T count:0} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) dot count
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) is Box
column3: bare schema name admits any instantiation (ancestry)

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) is (Box of [Integer])
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) is (Box of [String])
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) is (Box of [Number])
column3: v1 is invariant — no covariant admission (§15a pin)

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) is Class
# §2  equality
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) deq (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1})
column3: same instantiation + same fields are deq-equal

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) deq (make (Box of [String]) {value:'1'})
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) eq (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1})
# §3  strict typing + sealing carry over
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end make (Box of [Integer]) {value:'no'}
column3: the substituted field type is enforced at make

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end def b (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) b set value 'no'
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end def b (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:1}) b set extra 9
column3: instances stay sealed, with the canonical name in the error

column1: def Stack gen [T] class {items:[:T]} end (make (Stack of [Integer]) {items:[1 2]}) dot items
column3: a typed-list field substitutes and constructs

column1: def Stack gen [T] class {items:[:T]} end make (Stack of [Integer]) {items:['x']}
def Pos (Float gte 0.0) def G gen [(T extends Number)] class {v:T r:Pos} end make (G of [Integer]) {v:1 r:-1.0}
column3: predicate-typed fields still run their predicate

column1: # §4  subclassing
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def P refine (Box of [Integer]) {tag:'x'} end (make P {value:1}) is (Box of [Integer])
column3: an instantiation subclasses like any class

column1: def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def P refine (Box of [Integer]) {tag:'x'} end (make P {value:1}) is Box
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def Sub refine Box {extra:1}
column3: subclassing the SCHEMA itself is rejected (instantiate first)

column1: # §5  serialization — $class carries the canonical instantiation name
import "boru:struct-util"  def Box gen [T] class {value:T} def a (make (Box of [Integer]) {value:42}) (StructUtil.reify (Box of [Integer]) (StructUtil.jsonify a)) deq a
